response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and has no demonstrable background in large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, distributed systems, or technical leadership in cloud platforms — instead, their experience is predominantly in web, mobile, and GIS applications using TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with minimal evidence of the core technical qualifications for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across multiple languages and domains
Proven track record of open-source contributions and technical mentoring
Extensive experience with CI/CD, testing practices, and dev-ops tooling
concerns: No evidence of 8+ years of C++ programming as required
Lacks experience in cloud compute platforms, distributed systems, or infrastructure design
No demonstrated technical leadership in cloud or DevOps engineering teams
